description: On the AJ V6 petrol engines, coil-on-plug ignition coils degrade over time, causing misfires, rough idle and check-engine warnings — often accelerated by oil contamination from leaking valve cover gaskets. We replace worn coils and address the underlying gasket leak together, not just the symptom.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: ZSD-420/422 injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are widely documented across Jaguar specialist forums and official TSBs.

heroHook.title: Include In Hero Hook:
heroHook.body: Yes — both verified: ZSD-420/422 widely documented with multiple TSBs; M156 pre-2012 established Jaguar specialist pattern.

features.title: New Timing Chains
features.body: Replaced as standard (where worn or damaged)

features.title: Peace Of Mind
features.body: No hidden extras — just a stronger, longer-lasting engine
